propositions: Cloud and DataCenter encode Markdown descriptions and comments as plain-text rather than structured ADF or wiki markup, causing literal markdown syntax to appear in Jira
Jira-authored rich text (panels, mentions, dates) reads as noise when pulled into rebar due to lack of bidirectional fidelity and origin-gating
Round-trip Markdown↔ADF encoding must reach idempotence (99%+ fixed point) across corpus without content erosion or length decay over repeated passes
DataCenter wiki markup rendering requires safe unit segmentation with pandoc fallback and must preserve Jira-native constructs through origin-gated outbound comparison
Echo safety must suppress unchanged second passes and flag concurrent edits via three-way baseline/local/remote comparison using ADR-0026 baseline plus rich_sha change-gating
Comment synchronization requires append-only local-comment-key→Jira-ID mapping with codec-routed creation but no edit/delete mirroring
